subject.facility_name: Hebrew Center For Health And Rehabilitation

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $174.11 per resident day (39.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 0.7% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $250,745, 1.8% of the $13,788,698 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $3,292,349, $41.57 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $1,410,772 (42.9%), allocated fringe $486,311 (14.8%), non-wage costs $1,395,266 (42.4%). Raw food was $1,198,367 ($15.13 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $29,153.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $1,419,676, $17.93 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $989,504 (69.7%), allocated fringe $341,095 (24.0%), non-wage costs $89,077 (6.3%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $722,604, $9.12 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $160,337 (22.2%), allocated fringe $55,270 (7.6%), non-wage costs $506,997 (70.2%).
Missing data: cost years 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
